business_summary: ZIGExN Co., Ltd. operates the life service platform worldwide. The company provides vertical HR services such as, rejob; rejobcare; miraxs-sitter; Kensetsu-JOBs; Realestateworks; Ties; Dorapita; Recruitment Strategy & Execution/Operation; and ALPHA RESORT platforms. It also offers life services including, smocca; Sekaiproperty; Hikkoshi-EX; reshop-navi; reshop-navi exterior; reshop-navi gaiheki tosou; Gaiheki-concierge; enepi; Griene; Yeay; Hoken-Mammoth; renoco; Arubaito-ex; Matchingood-haken; Matchingood-Jinzai; CareerPlus; MyRec for MA/Retention Support; Bizcomi; Franchise-hikaku; appleworld; Travelist; BPO; Galantour; Rikisha; TASA; Chukosha-EX; Kuruma-kaitori-EX; TCV; SellTrade; Kekkon-sodansho-hikaku; Kateikyoshi-kuraberu; Ryugaku-kuraberu; fabiz; Hikakaku!; and Minaoshi platforms. ZIGExN Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ZIGExN Co., Ltd.는 2006년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
